compute_dice_loss: compute the DICE loss for mask predictions similar to generalized IOU for masks
compute_sigmoid_ce_loss: compute sigmoid cross-entropy loss with logits for binary mask classification
create_VideoSetCriterion: create a VideoSetCriterion module that computes hungarian-matched losses for masks, bboxes, and labels
run_VideoSetCriterion_forward: run the VideoSetCriterion forward pass to compute all requested losses with optional auxiliary outputs
compute_uncertain_point_coords: sample uncertain point coordinates using top-k uncertainty and random sampling for mask supervision
